name: Flamekin Village
oracle_text:
As this land enters, you may reveal an Elemental card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.
{T}: Add {R}.
{R}, {T}: Target creature gains haste until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: As this land enters, you may reveal an Elemental card from your hand. If you don't, this land enters tapped.

needs.what: a cost that reveals a card matching a selector (here an Elemental card) from the payer's hand, the card staying in hand, usable as a self_enters_tapped replacement's `unless_cost` so the land enters untapped only if the player chooses to reveal one
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `unless_cost` on self_enters_tapped is offered through costs.can_pay/pay, but no cost key reveals from hand only: `behold` also accepts a permanent you control (so an Elemental on the battlefield would wrongly untap the land), and `exile_from_hand`/`discard_selector` move the card. The starting point's bare self_enters_tapped makes the land always enter tapped, which proxy.py itself flags as 'the printed condition is not modelled'. The haste line is expressible with grant_keyword on a target creature
